observable: Completion and original assertions of one frozen official test stage
variant: Identical fixed upstream assertion workload. There is no graded continuous output in this assertion harness, so this pair supplies no floating-point spread evidence; its exact assertion verdict is not presented as numerical tolerance calibration. The two TALOS checks provide continuous two-ULP calibration.
altbuild: none: the pinned source has been validated on one O2 compiler/dependency environment; no alternative build evidence is claimed.

evidence.spread_how: Both fixed assertion runs must pass. Their identical discrete verdict provides no numeric spread evidence.

warrant: The immutable upstream regression snapshot executes py-task-posture. Its original assertions compare the library operations against independently computed expectations or explicit constraint properties; every selected stage must complete with at least one passed assertion and no failed assertion. A failed or skipped stage is rejected. Counts are not required to equal across runs because an iterative test can converge in a different number of valid steps. Numerical tolerances inside the frozen upstream assertions remain the upstream values; this discrete gate introduces no new numerical equivalence bound.
